intitule: Asking for Directions - Complete the Dialogue

enonce.texte:
Instructions: Complete the dialogue between a person asking for directions and a person giving them.

Person A: "______ me, where is the hospital?"

Person B: "Go ______ and then turn ______ at the traffic lights."

Person A: "______ is the bank?"

Person B: "The bank is ______ the post office and the school."

Person A: "Thank you very ______!"

Person B: "You're ______."

intitule: Giving Directions - Fill in the Blanks

enonce.texte:
Instructions: Complete the sentences with the correct direction word: turn left, turn right, go straight, go past, take the first/second road.

  1. "______ at the church, then you will see the market."
  2. "______ for two blocks, then ______ at the bank."
  3. "______ the post office, and the library is on your left."
  4. "______ at the roundabout, then ______ the second road on your right."

enonce.texte:
Instructions: Complete the dialogue between a passenger and a bus driver.

Passenger: "Excuse me, ______ this bus go to the market?"

Driver: "Yes, it ______. Get off at the third stop."

Passenger: "Thank you. How ______ does it cost?"

Driver: "It ______ 200 CFA."

Passenger: "Here you ______. Thank you."

Directions: Go straight for 100 meters. Turn left at the church. The bank is on your right. Go past the bank and turn right. The hospital is in front of you.

Question: Where are you?

questions.texte: Where are you at the end?

intitule: Create a Dialogue - Asking for Directions

enonce.texte: Instructions: Create a dialogue (at least 8 exchanges) between a tourist and a local person. The tourist wants to go to the market. Use polite expressions, directions, and means of transportation.

questions.texte: Create a dialogue asking for directions to the market.
questions.reponse: Example: Tourist: "Excuse me, can you help me, please?" Local: "Yes, of course." Tourist: "How can I get to the market?" Local: "Go straight for 200 meters, then turn left at the bank. The market is on your right." Tourist: "Is it far?" Local: "No, it is about 5 minutes walking." Tourist: "Thank you very much!" Local: "You're welcome. Have a nice day!"

enonce.texte:
Instructions: Write a short paragraph (6-8 sentences) describing how you go to school. Use directions, prepositions of place, and means of transportation.

Hint: Include: where you start, what transportation you use, the streets you take, and the places you pass.

questions.texte: Write a paragraph describing your journey to school.
questions.reponse: Example: I go to school by car. I start from my house. I go straight for 500 meters. Then I turn right at the church. I pass the market on my left. The school is opposite the bank. It takes me 10 minutes to get to school.

intitule: Identify Directions - Look at the Map

enonce.texte:
Instructions: Look at the map and answer the questions.

Map:

  • Start: School
  • Places: Bank, Market, Church, Hospital, Police Station
  • School is next to the bank.
  • The market is opposite the school.
  • The church is between the bank and the hospital.
  • The police station is behind the market.

questions.reponse: The school is next to the bank.
The market is opposite the school.
The church is between the bank and the hospital.
The police station is behind the market.
